adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` call is wrapped in `try { ... } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which both swallows the failure and discards the actual `err` value. This is directly shown in the diff and makes email-delivery/render/SMTP failures hard to diagnose while the mutation still returns success (`return { message: "Guests added" }`). It’s primarily an observability/error-handling concern rather than a strictly broken behavior in the core “add guests” operation.
